info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 39h online + 3h offline + 1h TE + 107h self-study
info.description: This intensive and hands-on series of courses gives you the skills to utilize conceptual frameworks to align IT investments with business strategy, assess the fit between business requirements and enterprise systems features, specify business requirements as information system specifications and evaluate technological alternatives for developing the IT infrastructure for the organization.
info.studentTasks:
1. Student must get the certification of Information​ ​Systems specialization specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination.

2. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam
info.note:
1. Students complete the online courses and get all specialization certifications to be allowed to take Final Exam

2. Final Exam included Final Theory Exam (TE): 100%

3. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5
